note: Synthetic operations handbook for bench/kb. Every entity is invented.

policies.name: Incident severity
policies.text: Sev 1 is customer-visible downtime, paged immediately to the owning team. Sev 2 is degraded service, acknowledged within 30 minutes. Sev 3 is cosmetic and handled in business hours.

policies.name: Deploy freeze
policies.text: No production deploys during the last two business days of the quarter, except for Sev 1 fixes approved by the owning team lead.

policies.name: Data retention
policies.text: Application logs are kept 30 days. Audit logs are kept 400 days. Customer records are deleted within 30 days of a verified request.

policies.name: Oncall handoff
policies.text: Oncall rotates weekly on Monday at 09:00 in the team's lead timezone, with a written handoff in the team channel.

policies.name: Access review
policies.text: Production access is reviewed quarterly. Any access unused for 90 days is revoked automatically.

policies.name: Cost guardrail
policies.text: Any service above 2,000 dollars a month in compute needs a named owner and a monthly review.

policies.name: Search relevance
policies.text: Every relevance change ships behind a traffic split of at least 5%, held for 72 hours before full rollout.

policies.name: Payment retries
policies.text: Failed charges retry three times over 48 hours with exponential backoff, then settle to manual review.
